ever passed off as children's entertainment
The series focuses on six elementary school students and their interaction with other classmates and teachers

a group of good friends, 4 boys and 2 girls
Easily one of the smartest, most prankishly playful adult cartoons
defending their freedom against perceived threats by adults and school administration
